name: rsync
description: The rsync package contains the rsync utility. This is useful for synchronizing large file archives over a network.

package:
cat > $DESTDIR/etc/rsyncd.conf << "EOF"
# This is a basic rsync configuration file
# It exports a single module without user authentication.

motd file = /home/rsync/welcome.msg
use chroot = yes

[localhost]
    path = /home/rsync
    comment = Default rsync module
    read only = yes
    list = yes
    uid = rsyncd
    gid = rsyncd

EOF

post_install:
id -u rsyncd >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -c "rsyncd Daemon" -m -d /home/rsync -g rsyncd \
    -s /bin/false -u 48 rsyncd
